24: ## Phase 1: Trigger + Client Restructure (PR#1)
25: 
26: Traceability: `[gym-rankings: Metric Authority — Server-Computed, Not Client-Asserted]`, `[gym-rankings: Opt-In Enable — Metrics Populate via Server-Side Recompute]`, `[gym-rankings: Session Finish — No Longer the Client Authority for Metrics]`, `[gym-rankings: Opt-In Disable — Unchanged, Client-Initiated]`, `[AD-1]`, `[AD-2]`, `[AD-3]`, `[AD-5]`, `[AD-6]`, `[AD-7]`, `[AD-9]`.

30: ### 1a — Trigger (`functions/src/ranking-aggregate.ts`)
31: 
32: - [ ] 1.1 RED: `functions/src/__tests__/ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — port `familyMaxWeight`/`kMainLiftFamilies` test fixtures to TS and write the first failing scenario per `[AD-7]`: **first-finish recompute** — seed `users/{uid}/sessions` with one finished+fully-completed session (`totalVolumeKg`, `setLogs` subcollection with a `squat-barra` log), seed `userPublicProfiles/{uid}` with `rankingOptIn:true`, call `recomputeMetrics(app, uid)` directly, assert `lifetimeVolumeKg`/`bestSquatKg` written correctly. Import from `../ranking-aggregate` (module does not exist yet — RED by construction, mirrors `review-aggregate.test.ts`'s import-before-implementation pattern).
33: - [ ] 1.2 GREEN: Create `functions/src/ranking-aggregate.ts` — port `K_MAIN_LIFT_FAMILIES` (squat/bench/deadlift ids, per design Interfaces/Contracts) and a TS `familyMaxWeight(lift, logs)` helper from `lib/features/gym_rankings/domain/main_lift_family_map.dart`. Implement `recomputeMetrics(app, uid)`: query `users/{uid}/sessions` `orderBy('startedAt','desc').limit(365)` (port `counterRecomputeWindow=365` as a named TS const), filter `status=='finished' && wasFullyCompleted==true`, sum `totalVolumeKg` → `lifetimeVolumeKg`; per matching session read its `setLogs` subcollection, compute `best<Lift>Kg` via the ported helper; gate the whole write on `userPublicProfiles/{uid}.rankingOptIn === true` (else write metrics to `0`/`null` per AD-2's opt-out-race note); catch-log-never-rethrow; no-op + warn if profile doc absent (mirrors `recomputeAggregate`'s REQ-RV-CF-006 shape). Run scenario 1.1 to GREEN.
34: - [ ] 1.3 RED: extend `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — **second-session recompute** (two qualifying sessions, volumes sum correctly) and **idempotent re-fire** (`recomputeMetrics` called twice with identical underlying data yields identical output, per `[AD-7]`).
35: - [ ] 1.4 GREEN: no production code change expected if 1.2 is correct (recompute is a pure full-requery, inherently idempotent) — run to confirm GREEN; if not, fix `recomputeMetrics` until both pass.
36: - [ ] 1.5 RED: extend `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — **forged-value overwrite** per `[gym-rankings: Metric Authority — Forged client value does not appear on the leaderboard]`: seed `userPublicProfiles/{uid}` with a forged `bestSquatKg: 999` (simulating a pre-rules-hardening write) alongside real sessions yielding a true max of `110`; call `recomputeMetrics`; assert the stored value is overwritten to `110`, never `999`.
37: - [ ] 1.6 GREEN: confirm 1.2's full-requery-and-overwrite semantics already satisfy this (no forged-value special-casing needed — the recompute always derives from source sessions, ignoring whatever was previously stored). Run to GREEN; this is the core security assertion of the whole change — do not skip.
38: - [ ] 1.7 RED: extend `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — **no-op if profile absent** (mirrors SCENARIO-593): call `recomputeMetrics` for a uid with sessions but no `userPublicProfiles` doc; assert it resolves without throwing and writes nothing.
39: - [ ] 1.8 GREEN: confirm 1.2's profile-existence guard covers this. Run to GREEN.
40: - [ ] 1.9 RED: extend `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — **opt-out gating** per `[gym-rankings: Metric Authority]` + AD-2: seed `userPublicProfiles/{uid}` with `rankingOptIn:false` and real qualifying sessions; call `recomputeMetrics`; assert metrics are written as `0`/`null` (not the derived real values) — a disabled athlete's doc must never carry live-looking metrics even if the trigger fires on a stray session write.
41: - [ ] 1.10 GREEN: implement the `rankingOptIn` gate branch in `recomputeMetrics` (write `{lifetimeVolumeKg:0, bestSquatKg:null, bestBenchKg:null, bestDeadliftKg:null}` when not opted in, instead of the derived values). Run to GREEN.
42: - [ ] 1.11 RED: extend `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — **Trigger A wiring**: export `rankingAggregateOnSession` as `onDocumentWritten({document: "users/{uid}/sessions/{sessionId}", region: "southamerica-east1"}, ...)` calling `recomputeMetrics(getApp(), uid)` with `uid` from `event.params.uid`. Test asserts the exported function exists and is invocable (unit-level; full trigger-harness firing is covered by the emulator write-and-poll pattern below in 1.13).
43: - [ ] 1.12 GREEN: implement `rankingAggregateOnSession` in `ranking-aggregate.ts` per 1.11, reusing the module's own `getApp()` lazy-init helper (port verbatim from `review-aggregate.ts`).
44: - [ ] 1.13 RED: extend `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` — **Trigger B loop-prevention / single-write termination** per `[AD-1]` (the load-bearing test the skill explicitly calls out): write `userPublicProfiles/{uid}` directly via the Admin SDK test client transitioning `rankingOptIn` `false→true` (simulating what `enableRankingOptIn` will do post-restructure), assert `recomputeMetrics` runs exactly once and the resulting doc write does NOT cause a second recompute — instrument via a call counter injected into a test-only wrapper OR assert via a short poll window that only one metrics-write timestamp/version appears. Also add the **no-session opt-in** case: a just-opted-in athlete with zero qualifying sessions ends up with `lifetimeVolumeKg:0`/`best*Kg:null` (per `[gym-rankings: Opting in with zero qualifying sessions shows zero, not stale or forged data]`).
45: - [ ] 1.14 GREEN: implement `rankingAggregateOnOptIn` as `onDocumentWritten({document: "userPublicProfiles/{uid}", region: "southamerica-east1"}, ...)` with the AD-1 transition guard: `if (!(before?.rankingOptIn !== true && after?.rankingOptIn === true)) return;` before calling `recomputeMetrics`. This is the single line that makes the loop terminate — the re-fire triggered by `recomputeMetrics`'s own merge write has `before.rankingOptIn === after.rankingOptIn === true`, so the guard short-circuits. Run 1.13 to GREEN; if the test shows more than one recompute call, the guard condition is wrong — do not proceed until this is provably single-write.
46: - [ ] 1.15 Modify `functions/src/index.ts` — export `rankingAggregateOnSession` and `rankingAggregateOnOptIn` from `./ranking-aggregate`, following the existing one-line-per-export convention (append near `reviewAggregate`'s export, update the header comment block to mention this PR per the file's existing changelog-in-comment style).
47: - [ ] 1.16 Quality gate (functions layer): `npm --prefix functions run build` (TS compiles clean), `npm --prefix functions test` (Jest+emulator, all `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` scenarios green — requires `FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST` set, same as `review-aggregate.test.ts`'s documented precondition).

51: - [ ] 1.17 RED: `test/features/profile/application/ranking_optin_controller_test.dart` — extend per `[gym-rankings: enableRankingOptIn no longer computes metrics client-side]`: assert `enableRankingOptIn(uid)` writes `gymId`/`gymName` (unchanged AD-5 denorm path) then `rankingOptIn:true`, and does **NOT** call `_sessionRepository.listRecentCompletedByUid`/`listSetLogs` at all, and does **NOT** write `lifetimeVolumeKg`/`best<Lift>Kg` via `updateCounters` (assert the fake/spy repository records zero metric-field writes from this call). This will fail against the current implementation, which still computes and writes all 4 metrics.
52: - [ ] 1.18 GREEN: Modify `lib/features/profile/application/ranking_optin_controller.dart` — remove the metric-backfill block (lines ~80-107: `listRecentCompletedByUid`, the `allLogs` loop, `familyMaxWeight` calls, the `updateCounters` call for the 4 metrics). `enableRankingOptIn` becomes: resolve `profile.gymId` → `_userRepository.update(uid, {'gymId': profile?.gymId})` (AD-5 path, unchanged) → `_publicProfileRepository.setRankingOptIn(uid, true)` LAST. Remove now-unused imports (`main_lift_family_map.dart`, `set_log.dart`) if nothing else in the file references them. Update the class doc comment (lines 25-55) to describe the new intent-only contract and point to the server-side trigger as metric authority.
53: - [ ] 1.19 RED: `test/features/workout/data/session_repository_test.dart` — extend per `[gym-rankings: Finishing a qualifying session updates leaderboard metrics via the server path]` + `[workoutsCount and racha still update as before]`: assert `finish()` still writes `workoutsCount`/`racha` to `userPublicProfiles` exactly as before, but does **NOT** write `lifetimeVolumeKg`/`best<Lift>Kg` (assert zero writes to those 4 fields, and that `pubRepo.get(uid)` / `listSetLogs` are no longer called for metric purposes — only the counters path remains).
54: - [ ] 1.20 GREEN: Modify `lib/features/workout/data/session_repository.dart` — remove the ranking-metric block (lines 117-162: the `profile.rankingOptIn` branch, `lifetimeVolumeKg` fold, `logsBySession`/`allWindowLogs`, `mergeBest`, and the 4 `counters[...]` assignments). Keep the surrounding `workoutsCount`/`racha` counters write (lines 109-116, 164) untouched. Remove the now-unused `familyMaxWeight`/`MainLift`/`SetLog` imports if nothing else in the file references them. Update the method's doc comment (lines 100-107) to remove the stale ranking-metric denormalization description and note the server-side trigger now owns that.
55: - [ ] 1.21 Quality gate (Dart client layer): `flutter analyze lib test` (0 new issues vs. baseline ~33), `dart format .`, `flutter test test/features/profile/application/ranking_optin_controller_test.dart test/features/workout/data/session_repository_test.dart` green.

57: ### Phase 1 gate
58: 
59: - [ ] 1.22 Full quality gate: `flutter analyze lib test` (0 new issues), `dart format .`, `flutter test` (full suite) green, `npm --prefix functions run build` clean, `npm --prefix functions test` green. Commit as a single work unit (or two work-unit commits: 1a trigger+tests, 1b client restructure+tests — both land in the same PR#1 per AD-9, ordering within the PR does not matter, only PR#1-before-PR#2 does).
60: - [ ] 1.23 Manual step (non-code, do NOT run): `firebase deploy --only functions` to ship `rankingAggregateOnSession`/`rankingAggregateOnOptIn` to `southamerica-east1`. Note only — this is a human/CI deploy action, not part of this checklist's automated scope. Confirm via Firebase Console or `firebase functions:list` post-deploy that both functions are live BEFORE merging any PR#2 rules change (AD-9 hard dependency).

62: ## Phase 2: Rules Hardening (PR#2)
63: 
64: Traceability: `[user-public-profiles-layer: Firestore Rules — Field Allowlist]`, `[user-public-profiles-layer: Firestore Rules — Owner-Only and UID Immutability]`, `[user-public-profiles-layer: Firestore Rules — gymId Integrity]`, `[user-public-profiles-layer: Firestore Rules — CF-Write-Only Ranking Metrics]`, `[user-public-profiles-layer: Firestore Rules — Type and Range Validation]`, `[user-public-profiles-layer: Read Access Unchanged]`, `[AD-3]`, `[AD-4]`, `[AD-8]`, `[AD-9]`. Hard dependency: Phase 1 (trigger deployed and live) MUST ship and be confirmed live BEFORE this phase merges — see AD-9 and task 1.23.
65: 
66: - [ ] 2.1 RED: `test/firestore/user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart` (new file, mirrors `test/firestore/payments_rules_test.dart`'s CI-skipped-stub structure — documents intent, does NOT enforce in CI per the pre-existing gap, AD-7/Q5) — write stub scenarios for the field allowlist per `[user-public-profiles-layer: Write containing an unknown field is denied]` and `[Write containing only known fields succeeds]`. This file is created as failing-by-absence (the file doesn't exist yet); mark each `test(...)` with `skip: 'emulator required — run with firebase emulators:exec'` per the established pattern — "RED" here means the file does not yet exist / rule does not yet enforce, not a CI-red run.
67: - [ ] 2.2 GREEN: Modify `firestore.rules` (`userPublicProfiles` match block, lines 312-334) — add `request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly([15 field names from the spec])` to both `create` and `update` conditions. Fix the stale header comment (line 313-314, currently says "Contains ONLY the 5 public fields...") to list all 15 fields per `[user-public-profiles-layer: Firestore Rules — Field Allowlist]`.
68: - [ ] 2.3 RED: extend `user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart` — stub scenarios for `[gymId Integrity: Athlete cannot self-assign to a gym they don't attend]` and `[Athlete can write their own real gymId]`.
69: - [ ] 2.4 GREEN: Modify `firestore.rules` — add the `gymId` cross-doc pin to the `update` (and `create`, where relevant for onboarding — confirm order-of-writes per AD-4: `users/{uid}` must exist first) condition: `(!request.resource.data.keys().hasAny(['gymId']) || request.resource.data.gymId == get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.gymId)`, following the exact `get()` pattern already used at `firestore.rules:389` for the trainer-role check. Handle the null/`kNoGymId` case per AD-4 (`users/{uid}.gymId` blank ⇒ public `gymId` must also be blank/matching, not an automatic pass).
70: - [ ] 2.5 RED: extend `user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart` — stub scenarios for `[CF-Write-Only Ranking Metrics: Client raw-write of a forged metric value is denied]`, `[Client write that re-asserts the existing metric value is not rejected]`, and `[Server-side recompute writes new metric values via Admin SDK]` (documents that Admin SDK bypasses rules entirely — no rule assertion needed for this one, note it as such in the stub).
71: - [ ] 2.6 GREEN: Modify `firestore.rules` — add CF-write-only pins for the 4 metric fields on `update`: for each of `lifetimeVolumeKg`/`bestSquatKg`/`bestBenchKg`/`bestDeadliftKg`, require `(!request.resource.data.keys().hasAny(['<field>']) || request.resource.data.<field> == resource.data.<field>)`. On `create`, require the 4 fields be ABSENT or at fixed defaults (`lifetimeVolumeKg == 0`, `best*Kg == null`) per AD-3 — a create cannot seed forged values.
72: - [ ] 2.7 RED: extend `user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart` — stub scenarios for `[Type and Range Validation: Out-of-range numeric metric value is rejected]` and `[Non-boolean rankingOptIn value is rejected]`.
73: - [ ] 2.8 GREEN: Modify `firestore.rules` — add type/range guards per AD-8: numeric metric fields must be `number` type and within `<= 1000` (per-lift) / `<= 100_000_000` (lifetime volume) when present on the write; `rankingOptIn` must be `bool` type when present. Combine with the allowlist/pin conditions added in 2.2/2.6 (single `allow update:` boolean expression, following the existing single-condition-per-rule style in this ruleset).
74: - [ ] 2.9 RED: extend `user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart` — stub scenarios for `[Owner-Only and UID Immutability: Non-owner write is denied regardless of allowlist compliance]` and `[uid field cannot be changed on update]`, and `[Read Access Unchanged: Authenticated user reads any profile after the rules hardening]` — these assert the PRE-EXISTING invariants still hold, not new behavior; include them for completeness/regression documentation per the spec's restated requirements.
75: - [ ] 2.10 GREEN: confirm no rule change is needed for 2.9 (owner-check, uid-immutability, and open-read clauses are untouched by this change) — this task is a verification/no-op check, not a code change. If the combined boolean expression from 2.2-2.8 accidentally weakened any of these three invariants, fix it here.
76: - [ ] 2.11 Quality gate (rules + Dart layer): `flutter analyze lib test` (0 new issues), `dart format .`, `flutter test test/firestore/user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart` (all skipped, green-by-skip — documents intent, does not enforce per the pre-existing CI gap noted in AD-7/Q5).
77: - [ ] 2.12 Verification (manual, non-code): confirm the Phase 1 trigger (Admin SDK) still writes the 4 metric fields successfully against the NEW hardened rules — Admin SDK writes bypass Firestore rule evaluation entirely (per `[Server-side recompute writes new metric values via Admin SDK]`), so this is a sanity check, not a rule change. If an emulator is available locally, run `firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions "npm --prefix functions test"` to confirm `ranking-aggregate.test.ts` still passes against the new `firestore.rules` (Admin SDK test client also bypasses rules, so this mainly confirms no regression in the trigger itself, not rules interaction — note the limitation).
78: 
79: ### Phase 2 gate
80: 
81: - [ ] 2.13 Full quality gate: `flutter analyze lib test` (0 new issues), `dart format .`, `flutter test` (full suite) green, `npm --prefix functions run build` clean, `npm --prefix functions test` green (trigger unaffected by rules change — Admin SDK bypass). Commit as a single work unit (rules + Dart stub test together).
82: - [ ] 2.14 Manual step (non-code, do NOT run): `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` to ship the hardened rules. Note only. Confirm task 1.23's trigger deploy is ALREADY LIVE before running this — deploying tightened rules before the trigger exists breaks opt-in (AD-9: client can no longer write metrics, nothing else does yet).
83: 
84: ## Rules Applied
85: 
86: - Every impl (GREEN) task preceded by its RED (failing test) task, Strict TDD, mirroring `rankings-v2`'s structure. For the Dart rules test (2.1, 2.3, 2.5, 2.7, 2.9), "RED" means intent-documented-but-CI-skipped (pre-existing gap, not enforced) — this is explicitly noted per task, not silently assumed to be real coverage.
87: - AD-9 ship order is a HARD dependency, not a convenience split: Phase 1 (trigger + client restructure) MUST deploy and be confirmed live (task 1.23) before Phase 2 (rules hardening, task 2.14) ships. Reversing this order breaks opt-in for every athlete between the two deploys.
88: - The trigger's loop-termination (`[AD-1]`) has an explicit dedicated test (task 1.13/1.14) asserting single-write termination via the transition-equality guard — this is the single most safety-critical assertion in the change; do not mark 1.14 GREEN without it passing.
89: - Dart rules test (`test/firestore/user_public_profiles_rules_test.dart`) is documentation-only, CI-skipped, mirroring the pre-existing `payments_rules_test.dart`/`reviews_rules_test.dart` pattern — it does NOT enforce anything in CI. This is a known, accepted gap (AD-7/Q5), not a defect introduced by this change.
90: - Quality gate per slice: `flutter analyze lib test` 0 new issues (baseline ~33 pre-existing), `flutter test` green, `npm --prefix functions test` green (Jest+emulator), `npm --prefix functions run build` (TS compiles). `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,functions` is a manual, human/CI-run step — noted at tasks 1.23 and 2.14, never executed by this checklist's automation.
91: - Conventional commits, no AI attribution, work-unit commits (tests + implementation together per RED/GREEN pair, per delivery strategy).
